item.title: EU AI Act Checklist for Small Business: 6 Articles That Matter
item.description: Most SMEs and agencies I talk to have mentally filed the EU AI Act as someone else’s problem — 180+ articles of dense legal text, clearly written for hyperscalers and regulators, not a five-person creative studio or a research consultancy. That’s the wrong read. This is a practical EU AI Act checklist for small business: six articles decide almost everything a small team needs to know, and this is the one-page map to them.
